skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Colorful Wonderland CW03
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Colorful Wonderland series CW03. The cool and comfortable blends well with diverse decorations for a unique interpretation of summer.
skins.quote: Flowers in full bloom, the sea embracing the sky, brilliant memories amidst a shallow slumber. They all bring a smile to her face.

skins.name: Liberté//Échec
skins.content: I.T Brand UNDER GARDEN Collab Outfit/Liberté//Échec. A black and red base. A non-integrated design, with multiple accessories to select, the complete effect taking on personalized preferences.
skins.quote: Accomplishing deeds has no need for meaning. Where the mind goes, the body follows.
